mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, region, project, sub_element, clause_id, clause_name, node_type, level_no, status, create_time, update_time FROM wb_dict_clause_tree WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, parent_id, region, project, sub_element, clause_id, clause_name, node_type, level_no, status, create_time, update_time FROM wb_dict_clause_tree
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wb_dict_clause_tree (parent_id, region, project, sub_element, clause_id, clause_name, node_type, level_no, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{region}, #{project}, #{subElement}, #{clauseId}, #{clauseName}, #{nodeType}, #{levelNo}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
